w10_T4_002819: On Monday morning a school library had 18 new books on the trolley, and a delivery added 62 more before lunch. The library has 30 chairs around its tables. In the afternoon the books were shared equally among the 4 classrooms, and Class 1 took its share. Each of Class 1's books came with 8 worksheets tucked inside, and it took the teacher half an hour to check them. That evening 18 of those worksheets were lost on the bus home. How many worksheets does Class 1 still have?
w10_T4_002821: A stamp club has 9 members, and every member brought 39 stamps to the meeting. The treasurer added 17 stamps from the club box. Swaps with another club sent 19 stamps away, and 15 more stamps were too damaged to keep. Half of the members collect only birds. A dealer then donated 44 stamps to the club. How many stamps does the club have?
w10_T4_002824: Farah had 215 bricks stacked beside the shed, and her cousin Idris brought 38 more, a smaller load than hers. A skip firm added another 24 bricks to the same stack. Every brick in the stack weighs 6 pounds. A single stone slab weighing 18 pounds is stored on top of them. The shed door is 2 metres wide. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the stack?
w10_T4_002839: A hostel had 206 blankets in its store and sent 62 of them away for repair. Every blanket still in the store is stitched from 7 fabric panels. A box in the cupboard holds another 60 spare panels of the same kind. The housekeeper then used 127 panels to patch curtains around the building. How many panels does the hostel have?
w10_T4_002842: On Monday morning a seed farm counted 9 fields with 199 plants growing in each field. Every one of those plants carries 3 stems. In the afternoon the workers found that each stem holds 9 seed pods. A sample tray added 19 pods to the count, and in the evening a neighbour handed in 76 more. The farm expects double that number of pods next season. How many pods does the farm expect next season?
w10_T4_002844: A bakery had 204 cupcakes on the counter, and a late tray added 4 more. During the day 146 cupcakes were sold. Every cupcake left over was cut into 4 tasting slices, and half of the counter was cleared to make room for them. The slices were packed equally into 4 boxes for the morning market. The baker then added 15 loose slices to one of those boxes. How many slices are in that box?
w10_T4_002851: A florist bought 114 roses and split them equally between her 2 shop windows. From the left window 48 roses were sold on Friday, and 4 more wilted overnight. The shop stands 3 doors along from the bakery. Every rose still in the left window sells for 7 dollars. How many dollars are the roses in the left window worth?
w10_T4_002857: Yara had 101 tiles in her workshop, and her partner Sam brought 59 more, fewer than Yara already had. Every one of those tiles was cut into 4 squares. Each square carries 4 small studs on its back. During the move 606 studs snapped off and were lost. A cleaner found 8 loose studs under the bench and added them to the box, and the workshop counts its stock in single studs rather than in packs. How many studs does the workshop have?
w10_T4_002858: On Saturday morning a farm split 216 sacks of grain equally between its 2 barns. Later that morning 46 more sacks were delivered to the north barn. Every sack in the north barn holds 8 scoops of grain. In the afternoon 83 scoops were fed to the chickens, and a miller collected 432 scoops. That evening the farmer valued every scoop still in the north barn at 5 pence. How many pence is the north barn's grain worth?
w10_T4_002867: A museum gift shop had 227 postcards in stock, and 1 was torn and thrown away. The rest were divided equally between the shop's 2 counters. The front counter sold 78 postcards on Saturday. A printer then delivered 74 new postcards to the front counter. How many postcards are on the front counter?
w10_T4_002868: A publisher had 39 boxes of leaflets in the store and printed 72 more boxes. It sent 58 boxes to a conference and 25 boxes to a school. Every box still in the store holds 8 bundles. Each bundle contains 5 packs. Every pack has 7 leaflets in it. How many leaflets are in the store?
w10_T4_002877: A charity printed 5 batches of raffle tickets with 199 tickets in each batch. A volunteer added 38 tickets left over from last year. Every ticket carries 4 tear-off coupons. The draw takes place on the 12th of June. All of those coupons were shared equally among the charity's 4 branches. The office then sent 8 spare coupons to the Riverside branch. How many coupons does the Riverside branch have?
w10_T4_002880: On Monday morning a workshop had 131 metres of copper wire on the reel. A delivery added 7 metres before lunch, and the offcut bin gave up 5 more metres. In the afternoon 84 metres were used on a rewiring job. Every metre still in the workshop can be cut into 8 short leads, and the workshop measures its wire in metres rather than in centimetres. How many short leads can the workshop cut?
w10_T4_002882: On Saturday morning a book sale had 114 crates ready in the hall, 4 more arrived at the gate, and 12 latecomers each brought a crate. The organisers set out 2 identical rooms, and each room held that same number of crates. In the afternoon a barn was opened and 35 more crates were wheeled in. All of the crates were then shared equally among the 5 charities taking part. Every crate holds 9 books, and the parish council paid 300 pounds towards the hire of the hall. How many books did one charity receive?
w10_T4_002895: On Monday morning a school store held 226 boxes of pencils, and 62 boxes were sent over to the new building. In the afternoon every box left in the store was opened, and each one held 6 pencils. Those pencils were shared equally among the school's 6 classes. Each pencil comes with 4 spare leads in its case, and the school counts its supplies in single pencils rather than in boxes. How many spare leads did one class receive?
w10_T4_002897: On Monday morning a bottling plant had 137 crates in the yard, and a delivery brought 46 more. Every crate holds 9 boxes, and each box holds 6 jars. The plant has 3 loading bays, and a dozen staff work on the line. In the afternoon a supermarket bought 2666 jars. That evening 13 jars came back from a damaged pallet. How many jars are in the yard now?
w10_T4_002898: On Friday morning a hotel had 163 clean pillowcases, and 3 of them were torn and binned. Before lunch the laundry returned 72 more. In the afternoon all the pillowcases were divided equally between the hotel's 2 wings, and the east wing took its share upstairs. That evening a delivery brought 21 extra pillowcases to the east wing. How many pillowcases does the east wing have?
w10_T4_002904: A campsite has 4 fields, and each field holds 44 tent pitches. The owner marked out 69 more pitches along the river bank. A flood then closed 78 pitches for the rest of the season. A neighbour let the campsite use 7 pitches in his paddock. How many pitches does the campsite have?
w10_T4_002905: Elif knitted 93 squares on each of 9 winter evenings. All the squares were the same size. Her friend Deniz added 18 squares, far fewer than Elif had made. A neighbour donated another 3 squares to the pile. A charity then used 783 of the squares to make blankets. How many squares are left?
w10_T4_002906: On Saturday morning a stall set out 12 boxes with 3 doughnuts in each box. Before lunch 26 doughnuts were sold to passers-by. In the afternoon the baker brought 10 more doughnuts to the stall. In the evening every doughnut on the stall was cut into 3 tasting pieces. Visitors ate 56 of those pieces before closing time. How many pieces were left?
w10_T4_002909: A council bought 228 saplings and split them equally between its 2 parks. Every sapling planted in the north park was fastened to its stake with 9 plastic ties. The store shed held another 14 ties of exactly the same kind. The maintenance team then took 737 ties away for work in the town centre. How many ties are left for the north park?
w10_T4_002911: On Saturday morning a bakery had 51 trays in the kitchen and sent 45 of them out to the market. In the afternoon each tray still in the kitchen was fitted with 2 racks. Every rack was then filled with 9 buns. That evening 2 buns were burnt and thrown away. How many buns did the bakery have?
w10_T4_002915: A tea factory puts 53 bags into every packet, and each box holds 4 packets. A case is filled with 5 of those boxes, and one case was set aside for a hotel. A worker added 42 loose bags to that case, and then 229 bags were found damp and thrown out. The factory has been running for 70 years, and half of its staff work nights. Each bag left in the case makes 9 cups of tea, and every cup holds 3 ounces, since the hotel measures its drinks in ounces rather than in pints. How many ounces of tea can that case make?
w10_T4_002917: On Monday morning a nursery potted 158 seedlings, and in the afternoon it potted exactly the same number again, so 2 equal batches stood in the greenhouse. That evening a colleague brought in 33 more seedlings. Every seedling in the greenhouse grew 8 shoots over the summer. Each shoot opened 8 leaves. The greenhouse has 24 panes of glass. By autumn 14434 of those leaves had fallen. How many leaves were still on the plants?
w10_T4_002919: A publisher prints 38 pages in every booklet. Each folder holds 6 booklets, each crate holds 3 folders, and each pallet holds 8 crates. The lorry that left on Tuesday carried 8 identical pallets. A clerk added 72 loose pages to the load at the last minute. The lorry itself is 14 metres long. How many pages were on the lorry?
